summary: Resolve uncertain Claude attachment diagnostics before publishing recovery.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or member coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Graceful driver resume state gains optional pending-publication, parked-fault and reconciliation fields. Legacy resume state remains readable. Older images do not retain the new pending-operation safeguard on downgrade; mixed-image native execution is unverified.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption is required.

manual.detail: No installation or migration action is required.

recovery.detail: Transient diagnostic failures retain and retry the identical operation; known permanent failures park per binding until a replacement is admitted. Pending state transfers only through the existing graceful re-exec file. Abrupt process death can still lose the in-memory pending slot; crash durability and safe replay of that lost operation are not guaranteed.
